jobs.title: Head of Information Technology
jobs.description:
Head of Information Technology

Houston, TX | Onsite

About the Opportunity

Our client, a global leader in the industrial manufacturing and engineering sector, is seeking an experienced Head of Information Technology to lead its North American IT organization. This executive leadership role will serve as a strategic partner to senior leadership, driving technology initiatives that support business growth, operational excellence, cybersecurity, and digital transformation.

This is an outstanding opportunity for an accomplished IT executive who enjoys leading large, cross-functional teams while aligning technology strategy with business objectives across a complex global organization.

Position Overview

The Head of Information Technology is responsible for providing strategic, operational, and tactical leadership to the organization's Information Technology and Shared Services functions. This individual will oversee a high-performing IT organization, develop technology roadmaps, strengthen cybersecurity, and ensure IT initiatives support the company's long-term business strategy.

Key Responsibilities
Develop and execute the organization's IT strategy in alignment with business objectives.
Partner with executive leadership to identify technology solutions that improve operational efficiency and support future growth.
Lead enterprise technology planning, including infrastructure, applications, cybersecurity, and digital transformation initiatives.
Assess technology risks and oversee the organization's information security strategy.
Establish and maintain IT governance, policies, procedures, and best practices.
Drive continuous improvement through emerging technologies and process optimization.
Build strong relationships with internal stakeholders and external technology partners.
Foster a customer-focused IT organization that delivers exceptional service across the business.
Recruit, mentor, and develop a high-performing IT leadership team while establishing departmental goals and KPIs.
Evaluate organizational capacity and leverage contractors, managed services, and third-party resources as needed.
Review organizational structure and optimize team responsibilities to support evolving business needs.
Develop and manage annual operating budgets for all IT functions.
Report on IT performance, compliance, cybersecurity, strategic initiatives, and operational metrics to executive leadership.
Collaborate with global technology teams to ensure alignment with enterprise standards while addressing regional business priorities.
Stay informed of industry trends and emerging technologies to enhance organizational capabilities and improve business outcomes.

Qualifications
Required
Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field (or equivalent combination of education and experience).
Minimum of 15 years of progressive IT experience.
Minimum of 12 years in IT leadership positions with increasing responsibility.
Proven experience leading enterprise IT organizations and managing cross-functional teams.
Strong strategic planning, organizational leadership, and business partnership skills.
Demonstrated ability to influence senior leaders and drive enterprise-wide initiatives.
Experience developing high-performing teams and mentoring IT leaders.
Strong understanding of cybersecurity, governance, infrastructure, and enterprise technology operations.

Preferred
Experience working within a global or multinational organization.
Experience collaborating with international business units and global IT organizations.

Additional Information
Location: Houston, TX (Onsite)
Travel: Up to 40%
Standard Monday-Friday work schedule with occasional evening or weekend support as business needs require.

Why Consider This Opportunity?
Executive leadership role with significant strategic influence
Opportunity to lead enterprise-wide technology transformation initiatives
Collaborative, global business environment
Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits package
Strong opportunities for long-term career growth and advancement

jobs.title: Director of Information Technology, Digital and Data
jobs.description:
At NAYA, we’re on an exciting journey
- growing fast, sharing authentic, fresh, and nutritious Middle Eastern flavors, and building a team that grows with us. Our mission is to build genuine connections through the Middle Eastern flavors that nourish and inspire us.

You will love working at NAYA

We believe great people deserve great rewards. NAYA offers a comprehensive and people-focused benefits package designed to support you at work and beyond, including:
Competitive pay
to recognize your impact
Annual competitive bonus plan

401(k) with match

Paid Vacation time

Medical, dental, and vision insurance
to keep you healthy and thriving
Flexible Spending
and Commuter benefits
to make your life easier
Employee discounts
and free NAYA meals
— because we believe in enjoying what we serve
Employee Assistance, Pay on Demand, Pet Insurance, Identity Theft Protection, and much more!

At NAYA, you’ll find more than a job — you’ll find a community that values you, supports your goals, and celebrates your success.

About the Role

The Director, IT Digital & Data leads the development and evolution of technologies powering NAYA’s digital guest experience and enterprise data capabilities. This role owns the technical roadmap for online ordering, mobile, and loyalty, while building the data infrastructure that helps our teams make better decisions. Reporting to the Chief Information Technology Officer, you will partner closely with Operations, Marketing, Finance, and other Support Center teams.
You will connect the full guest journey, from device and ordering platform through the restaurant make line and pickup experience. You will also ensure NAYA’s data is reliable, accessible, and useful as we grow.

What You’ll Do

Lead our digital platforms

Own the technology strategy, architecture, and roadmap for guest-facing platforms, including eatnaya.com, online ordering, mobile apps, and loyalty.
Partner with Marketing and Operations to prioritize improvements that make ordering easier, support restaurant throughput, and create a better guest experience.
Oversee integrations and data flow across Toast POS, Olo ordering and loyalty products, payment processors, delivery partners, ezCater, and other platforms.
Set and monitor standards for availability, reliability, performance, quality, and security across the digital guest journey.
Lead major platform launches, redesigns, migrations, and other digital initiatives from planning through adoption and ongoing improvement.
Work with restaurant and Support Center partners to identify issues, resolve root causes, and improve how digital orders move from the guest’s device to the make line and pickup.

Build enterprise data capabilities

Define and execute NAYA’s enterprise data strategy, including architecture, pipelines, business intelligence tools, and reporting infrastructure.
Scale our Snowflake data warehouse to bring together trusted data from POS, inventory, digital channels, HCM, and other business systems.
Establish data governance, master data management, and data quality standards that create consistent definitions and dependable reporting.
Build scalable tools and processes that give Marketing, Operations, Finance, and other teams access to useful self-service analytics.
Support CRM capabilities, campaign segmentation, and measurement through well-designed data connections and controls.
Help leaders and teams use data effectively through training, clear reporting, and practical guidance.

Lead people, partners, and investments

Lead, develop, and mentor internal technical talent while building strong working relationships with external partners.
Manage vendor performance, service levels, technical roadmaps, and delivery commitments.
Own the Digital & Data IT operating budget and recommend technology investments based on business needs and measurable impact.
Communicate technical priorities, tradeoffs, progress, and risks clearly to partners across the business, including senior leadership.
Model NAYA’s values of Generosity, Authenticity, Teamwork, Community, Passion, and Consistency in how you lead and collaborate.

Who you are

A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, or equivalent practical experience.
10+ years of technology experience, including 3+ years in an IT leadership role at the Senior Manager or Director level.
4+ years of experience in restaurant, retail, or hospitality environments, with a strong understanding of how technology affects frontline operations and the guest experience.
Experience with Olo products, such as Engage, Rails, or Spendgo, and enterprise data warehousing platforms such as Snowflake.
Demonstrated ownership of a digital platform migration, major launch, or data warehouse build from planning through implementation.
Strong knowledge of system integrations, data architecture, platform reliability, and vendor management.
The ability to align Operations, Marketing, Finance, and technology partners around shared priorities.
The judgment to balance long-term architecture with the immediate needs of restaurants and guests.
Clear communication skills and the ability to make complex technical topics understandable to nontechnical partners.
A leadership style that builds trust, develops people, invites feedback, and follows through.

We do not discriminate based on race, color, creed, religion, gender (including gender identity or expression), pregnancy, childbirth or related medical conditions, sexual orientation, marital status, domestic violence, sexual violence or stalking victim status, ancestry, national origin, alienage or citizenship, age, disability, military or veteran status, genetic information or predisposing genetic characteristic, or other protected status.

jobs.title: Director, Enterprise Technology Strategy
jobs.description:
Director, Enterprise Technology Strategy

Houston, TX | Hybrid | 3-Year 1099 Contract-to-Hire | $140–$150/hour

ElevationHR is supporting a leading Houston-based energy and utility organization seeking a Strategy Leader, Enterprise Technology
to help solve complex business and operational challenges and shape the technologies the enterprise will need over the next 1–5 years
.

This is not a traditional Project Manager, Program Manager, or IT operations role
.

We are looking for a technology strategist who can walk into an ambiguous business problem, understand how business and physical operation actually work, identify where technology can create meaningful value, establish the strategy, influence architecture and investment decisions, and help turn that strategy into programs that deliver measurable results.

The right person can move comfortably between an executive strategy discussion and a deep technical conversation spanning hardware, software, infrastructure, cloud, data, AI, cybersecurity, IoT/IIoT, edge, connected assets, and emerging technology
.

What You'll Do

Partner with senior business and technology leaders to identify and solve complex enterprise and operational problems, including opportunities that have not yet become formal programs.
Develop 1–5 year technology strategies
connecting business priorities, enterprise architecture, emerging technology, investment decisions, and executable initiatives.
Analyze business and operational processes end to end to identify root causes, constraints, risks, and opportunities for technology-enabled improvement.
Evaluate the full technology ecosystem, from physical assets, sensors, edge and infrastructure to software, cloud, data, AI, cybersecurity, and digital platforms
.
Translate opportunities into business cases, architecture direction, investment priorities, technology roadmaps, and measurable outcomes.
Evaluate build, buy, integrate, partner, pilot, and scale
decisions based on business value rather than technology novelty.
Work across business, IT, engineering, architecture, data/AI, cybersecurity, vendors, and systems integrators to move strategy into execution.
Stay engaged through implementation and adoption to ensure technology produces measurable business and operational value.

What We're Looking For

Must Have

Significant experience developing enterprise technology strategy
and leading complex technology-enabled transformation.
Demonstrated breadth across both software/applications and hardware, infrastructure, IoT/IIoT, edge, connected assets, or physical technology
.
Experience taking initiatives from ambiguous business problem → strategy → architecture/investment decision → implementation → adoption → measurable value
.
Strong systems thinking across business processes, people, physical operations, data, software, infrastructure, and technology dependencies.
Experience personally advising CIOs, CTOs, VPs, Senior Directors, or comparable executives
on major technology, architecture, investment, or transformation decisions.
Technical depth across several areas such as enterprise architecture, cloud, infrastructure, software, data/AI, cybersecurity, IoT/IIoT, edge, or operational technology.
Ability to identify and shape opportunities where the problem, solution, or program has not already been defined
.
Strong executive communication with the ability to move naturally between business strategy, technical architecture, and measurable outcomes
.
Bachelor's degree in a relevant business, engineering, technology, or related discipline.

Preferred

Experience in utilities, energy, oil and gas, industrial, manufacturing, transportation, infrastructure, or another asset-intensive or mission-critical environment
.
Experience connecting digital technology to physical operations through IoT/IIoT, sensors, telemetry, edge, OT, automation, digital twins, computer vision, drones, GIS, or related technologies
.
Experience with operational resilience, high availability, emergency response, or other environments where technology directly affects physical operations or customers.
Experience taking emerging technologies or early-stage capabilities from concept or pilot into enterprise use.
Practical experience applying AI, machine learning, or intelligent automation
to real business problems.
Master's degree or MBA preferred.
Electric utility or transmission and distribution experience is a plus, but not required.

What Success Looks Like

Success isn't measured by the number of roadmaps created or projects launched.
You will help identify high-value opportunities before they become formal programs
, determine the right technology direction, influence investment and architecture decisions, help stand up the right initiatives, and stay connected through adoption and measurable business value.

We are looking for someone who naturally asks:

What problem are we actually solving?
What should the technology landscape look like three to five years from now?
What should we build, buy, integrate, pilot, scale, or stop? And how will we know it actually created value?

Engagement Details

Houston, TX | Hybrid

Full-time, 3-year 1099 contract-to-hire

$140–$150/hour

Approximately 40 hours per week
Local Houston candidates strongly preferred
Non-local candidates must be willing to relocate to Houston at their own expense
Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without sponsorship
No third-party C2C; an individual's own LLC may be considered

If your background combines enterprise technology strategy, systems thinking, executive influence, technical breadth, and end-to-end transformation ownership
, we'd like to hear from you.

jobs.description:
Company Description

PURE INSURANCE SOLUTIONS is a multi-company insurance agency licensed by the Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India (IRDAI), providing General and Life Insurance solutions across India for individuals, families, and businesses. With more than 2,000 clients and partnerships with over 15 leading insurers, the company offers a wide range of insurance products backed by reliable service. Its experienced team brings over 60 years of collective industry expertise, delivering thorough risk assessments, customized policy structures, and strong claims support with transparency and integrity. The agency covers diverse needs, including health, property, liability, motor fleets, project and asset protection, and cyber risk. As an insurer-neutral firm, PURE INSURANCE SOLUTIONS prioritizes unbiased, client-centered guidance and premium optimization without compromising coverage.

Role Description

The Vice President of Technology is a full-time, remote leadership role responsible for overseeing the organization’s technology strategy, architecture, and execution. This role will lead the IT function, including infrastructure, applications, data, and security, ensuring technology initiatives align with business objectives and regulatory requirements. The Vice President of Technology will manage cross-functional projects, collaborate with senior leadership to drive digital transformation, and evaluate new technologies that improve operational efficiency, customer experience, and risk management. Day-to-day responsibilities include defining IT roadmaps, guiding system integration and modernization efforts, managing vendor relationships, and establishing standards for technology governance, performance, and reliability. The role also includes building and mentoring a high-performing technology team and ensuring robust disaster recovery, cybersecurity, and compliance practices.

Qualifications

Strong Analytical Skills to interpret complex data, assess technology risks and opportunities, and support data-driven decision-making.
Deep expertise in Information Technology, including enterprise systems, cloud platforms, cybersecurity, and infrastructure management.
Proven experience in IT Strategy and Strategic Planning to design and implement long-term technology roadmaps aligned with business goals.
Demonstrated Project Management capabilities to lead cross-functional initiatives, manage timelines and budgets, and ensure successful delivery.
Experience in technology leadership roles, preferably within insurance, financial services, or other regulated industries.
Ability to collaborate effectively with executive leadership, business teams, and external partners in a remote environment.
Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and change management skills.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field; a relevant master’s degree or MBA is an advantage.

PURE INSURANCE SOLUTIONS is a multi-company insurance agency licensed by the Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India (IRDAI), providing General and Life Insurance solutions across India for individuals, families, and businesses. With more than 2,000 clients and partnerships with over 15 leading insurers, the company offers a wide range of insurance products backed by reliable service. Its experienced team brings over 60 years of collective industry expertise, delivering thorough risk assessments, customized policy structures, and strong claims support with transparency and integrity. The Vice President of Technology is a full-time, remote leadership role responsible for overseeing the organization’s technology strategy, architecture, and execution. The Vice President of Technology will manage cross-functional projects, collaborate with senior leadership to drive digital transformation, and evaluate new technologies that improve operational efficiency, customer experience, and risk management. Day-to-day responsibilities include defining IT roadmaps, guiding system integration and modernization efforts, managing vendor relationships, and establishing standards for technology governance, performance, and reliability. The role also includes building and mentoring a high-performing technology team and ensuring robust disaster recovery, cybersecurity, and compliance practices.

Strong Analytical Skills to interpret complex data, assess technology risks and opportunities, and support data-driven decision-making.
Deep expertise in Information Technology, including enterprise systems, cloud platforms, cybersecurity, and infrastructure management.

Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and change management skills.
